items.quote: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying
Speak unto Aaron, and to his sons, and unto all the children of Israel, and say unto them
items.claim: Moses is commanded to speak to Aaron, his sons, and the children of Israel
items.object: Aaron, his sons, children of Israel

items.quote: that will offer his oblation for all his vows, and for all his freewill offerings, which they will offer unto the LORD for a burnt offering
items.claim: Members of the house of Israel or strangers will offer oblations to the LORD
items.actor: he [of the house of Israel or strangers]

items.quote: Ye shall offer at your own will a male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats
items.claim: An unblemished male animal shall be offered at the offerer's discretion
items.object: male without blemish, of the beeves, of the sheep, or of the goats
